sloka: तानहं सहसैन्यान् वै सर्वानेवाभ्यसूदयम् ।ततः पुनर्दशग्रीवः पुत्रमक्षं महाबलम् ।। ५.५८.१२२ ।।।।
transliteration: tānahaṁ sahasainyān vai sarvānevābhyasūdayam ।tataḥ punardaśagrīvaḥ putramakṣaṁ mahābalam ।। 5.58.122 ।।।।

translations.english: "Since I killed all of them along with the army, the tenheaded Ravana sent out his mighty son Aksha together with many demons.
